acceptanceCriteria: A citation that starts a wrapped line is not counted as a definition; real duplicate definitions still fail.
A fixture test covers both cases and fails before the fix.
body: Found in lane tasksops-1022n (PR beamfall/corvint#1544). A Markdown paragraph that wraps so the next line begins with a backticked ID followed by a full stop (for example the line starting with TCD-V0-172 and a period) is read as a second definition of that requirement, so the check fails on prose that only cites the ID.

title: requirement-definitions-check counts a wrapped line starting with a requirement ID as a duplicate definition
